prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1067; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the adjuster following up on the claim you reported. Is it all right if I record this statement?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving in Katy, Texas, on a multi-lane road heading toward the freeway. I was moving from the center lane over to the right lane because I needed to exit.

Q: What did you see before you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and I didn't see anyone right beside me. I put on my signal and started to move over slowly. About halfway into the lane change, I felt a bump on my passenger side and heard metal scraping.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before the contact?

A: Not until it was already alongside me. It came out of what I think was a blind spot, toward the back of my car. I didn't have time to react.

Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway or strike anything else?

A: No. Both cars pulled over onto the shoulder after it happened. Nobody went into the ditch or hit a pole.

Q: How are you feeling since the collision?

A: My neck is really stiff and sore, and the pain runs up into the back of my head. I've had headaches most days. When I first got out of the car I felt okay, but by the next morning it was much worse.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic and I've been referred to a physical therapist. I'm still going to appointments.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my car fixed and I want to be able to work without pain. That's all I have for now.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
